row.category: Vertical SaaS (Healthcare, Education, Real Estate, Construction, Field Service)
row.evidence: The Follow Up Boss pricing page (Grow $58/user/month billed annually, Pro, Platform) lists no SSO or SCIM, and the help centre adds and removes team members by hand or CSV import under Admin > Team.
row.notes: No SCIM by absence: pricing page, help centre (Zendesk search for SCIM, SSO, Okta, Azure returned no articles), API docs index (llms.txt) and the Okta catalogue show no SCIM or customer SAML/OIDC SSO. Sign-in is moving to a shared Zillow professional-tools login with mandatory MFA. Pro is $416/mo including 10 users (+$41/user) and Platform $833/mo including 30 users (+$17/user), billed annually. The public REST API (API key or OAuth, on every plan) can list, get and delete users and manage groups and teams, but has no create-user endpoint, so it is not a provisioning path.

endpoints.purpose: Delete a user (admins only; reassigns the deleted user's leads)

webhooks_user_events.notes: Documented webhook events cover people (contacts), deals, stages, pipelines, email marketing and similar; no user (team member) events.

rate_limits.text: Sliding 10-second window; global context 250 requests, lower limits without an X-System-Key header.

limitations.text: No documented endpoint to create or invite a user; users are added in Admin > Team or by CSV import.
API keys carry the access level of the user that owns them; deleting the user invalidates the keys.

entra.notes: No Follow Up Boss entry in the Microsoft Entra saas-apps tutorial index (toc.json) on 2026-10-05; absence cannot be quoted.

jumpcloud.notes: Not in the JumpCloud SSO & SCIM applications list (navigation of jumpcloud.com/support/integrate-with-fortinet), but absence cannot be quoted.

fallbacks.notes: Team members are imported from a CSV (name, email, phone, role) under Admin > Teams; sign-in is a Zillow-shared login with MFA (c11, c26).
